statement: \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\frac{\varphi(k)}{11^k-1},\qquad \textnormal{For each positive integer }k\textnormal{, }\varphi(k)\textnormal{ counts the integers from one through }k\textnormal{ that are coprime to }k.\quad\varphi(1)=1.
